title: Complete proof of Erdős Problem #465: Points with Distances Avoiding Integers

problemStatement.plain: COMPLETED: Both sorry statements filled — first_conjecture_holds and second_conjecture_holds now genuinely proved.

proven: first_conjecture_holds: Sárközy bound implies N(X,δ)=o(X) via explicit X₀ = exp(exp(C·δ⁻³/ε))+1
second_conjecture_holds: Konyagin bound implies N(X,δ)<X^{1/2+ε} via rpow algebra with X₀ = (C+1)^(1/ε)

knowledge.progressSummary: COMPLETED: Proved 2 sorries → 0 sorries. first_conjecture_holds uses double-exp X₀ and log(log X) > K chain via Real.log_lt_log + Real.log_exp. second_conjecture_holds uses rpow_mul + field_simp to show (C+1)^(1/ε)^ε = C+1, then rpow_le_rpow for base monotonicity.
builtItems: Proved first_conjecture_holds: log(log X) divergence argument with explicit X₀
Proved second_conjecture_holds: rpow algebra showing C < X^ε for large X
Both proofs follow existing codebase patterns (cf. Erdos382Problem.lean)
insights: For asymptotic corollaries, choose X₀ = f(constants) where f inverts the relevant growth function
